mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEPQTDT ( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, AGENT_REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE ) ( SELECT #{BUYER}, /* 1 : BUYER */ #{QUOTATION_NO}, /* 2 : QUOTATION_NO */ #{QUOTATION_SEQ}, /* 3 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ #{REVISION}, /* 4 : REVISION */ #{AGENT}, /* 5 : AGENT */ #{AGENT_REVISION}, /* 6 : AGENT_REVISION */ 'C', BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')AS ATOS_DATE, #{ATOS_END_DATE}, /* 7 : ATOS_END_DATE */ #{ATOS_END_TIME}, /* 8 : ATOS_END_TIME */ ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, #{DSS_FLAG}, /* 9 : DSS_FLAG if(chk_str[1].equals("A") || chk_str[1].equals("B") || chk_str[1].equals("C")|| chk_str[1].equals("S")) : Y , 기타 : N */ #{DSS_CHOICE} /* 10 : DSS_CHOICE */ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 11 : BUYER */ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 12 : QUOTATION_NO */ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 13 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 14 : REVISION */ AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') )

UPDATE KEPRQDT /*deleteMasterMpRqQuotationReceiptSend*/ SET RECV_FLAG = 'GD' , CANCEL_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} /*CANCEL_USER_ID*/ , CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE , CANCEL_REMARK = #{CANCEL_REMARK} /*CANCEL_REMARK*/ WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} /*BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} /*QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} /*QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION = #{REVISION} /*REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')

UPDATE ICOMBYIT_ADD A /*updateNegoICOMBYIT_ADD*/ SET A.STATUS = 'R', A.DESCRIPTION = ( SELECT DECODE(B.CH_DESCRIPTION, '', A.DESCRIPTION, NULL, A.DESCRIPTION, B.CH_DESCRIPTION) FROM KEPMGPDT B WHERE B.BUYER = #{KEY_2} AND B.PM_NO = #{KEY_1} AND B.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION = A.REVISION AND B.STATUS = 'C' ), A.SPECIFICATION = (SELECT DECODE(B.CH_SPECIFICATION, '', A.SPECIFICATION, NULL, A.SPECIFICATION, B.CH_SPECIFICATION) FROM KEPMGPDT B WHERE B.BUYER = #{KEY_2} AND B.PM_NO = #{KEY_1} AND B.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION = A.REVISION AND B.STATUS = 'C' ) WHERE (A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION) IN ( SELECT B.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION FROM KEPMGPDT A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE A.BUYER=#{KEY_2} AND A.PM_NO=#{KEY_1} AND A.STATUS='C' AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE ) AND STATUS = 'C'

UPDATE ICOMBYIT /*updateNegoICOMBYIT*/ SET UNIT_PRICE=#{ATOB_UNIT_PRICE}, MSDS_NO = DECODE(#{MSDS_NO}, 'MS88888888', '', #{MSDS_NO}), MSDS_YN = DECODE(#{MSDS_YN}, '1', DECODE(#{MSDS_NO}, 'MS99999999', 'N', 'Y'), 'N'), MATERIAL_TYPE = (SELECT DECODE(CMC_HARMFUL_YN, 'Y', 'H', NULL) FROM KEPMSDSHD WHERE MSDS_NO = #{MSDS_NO}) WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{BUYER} AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=#{BUYER_ITEM_NO} AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
